_note: Round-1 draft (2026-07-12): Monk path — Shaolin, Martyr, Hierophant. Schema mirrors abilities-warrior.json (Conqueror exemplar). Sources: C&S PDF pp.42-45 (Shaolin), pp.46-48 (Martyr), pp.49-52 (Hierophant). Resource ids match class-abilities.json resourceType exactly: chakra, focus, sacredEnergy. No sub-pools — all three classes spend only their class resource (focus is an unbounded in-combat builder; generation rates need engine support, see questions). healing.dice extension: countBase + countPerLevel*level dice (Sacred Hand = (level+2)d10). Custom fields: costEqualsHealing (SE consumed equals the rolled heal, capped at remaining SE), outOfCombatCostMultiplier, healingMultiplierOfSacredHandDirect, costPercentOfMaxResource, usesPerRest.multiplier. Skipped always-on passives (need engine support, not clickable): Shaolin Martial Master + fist scaling table + Natural Defence; Martyr Blind Eyes, focus generation (Master of Focus 1/2, Focus Deity), Natural Defence, Focused Might, Blind Perception, Body of the Martyr; Hierophant Natural Defence, Numinous Strikes, Quickened Aid, Apotheosis (folded into affected ability descriptions). Open questions MK1-MK18 returned to orchestrator.

abilities.name: Leg Sweep
abilities.description: On hit, apply [your level / 2] (rounded up) Prone stacks to the target. Only one Essence of Chakra effect per attack.

abilities.name: Push Kick
abilities.description: On hit, the target makes a STR save (DC 8 + your proficiency + WILL modifier). On a failure it is pushed 15 ft away from you; if it collides with an obstacle large enough to stop it (similar-size creature or solid structure), it also gains [your level / 2] (rounded up) Dazed stacks. Only one Essence of Chakra effect per attack.

abilities.name: Iron Elbow
abilities._question: MK2 — Wounded value is 3d6 at level 2, 'increases by 1d6 per level': confirm (level+1)d6 total, rolled per application
abilities.description: On hit, apply a Wounded effect of [3d6, +1d6 per level above 2] that lasts until the start of your next turn. Only one Essence of Chakra effect per attack.

abilities.name: Defensive Arts
abilities._question: MK4 — DC is [8 + enemy's attack bonus], not a standard save DC; confirm, and confirm it consumes the reaction in both modes
abilities.description: Consumes your reaction. Vs a RANGED weapon attack: DEX save against DC [8 + enemy's attack bonus]; on success take no damage and you may use the ammunition to attack a target in range; on fail take half damage. Vs a MELEE weapon attack: same DEX save; on success take no damage and force the attacker to make a CON save, ending their turn on a fail (AP not carried over); on fail take half damage.

abilities.name: Step of the Wind
abilities._question: MK3 — AP cost not stated in the source; assumed 0 AP
abilities.description: For the rest of your turn: walk on surfaces as steep as 80 degrees, walk over quicksand/sand/water for up to 1 AP of movement at a time (a solid surface in between resets it), and you do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

abilities.name: Palm of Tranquillity
abilities.description: As part of an attack: the target must make a WILL save (DC 8 + your proficiency + WILL modifier) or be Silenced for 1 round.

abilities.name: Calm Soul
abilities.description: Until the end of your next turn: you have advantage on all saving throws, all attacks against you have disadvantage, but all your attacks also have disadvantage. No cost.

abilities.name: Spell Absorption
abilities.description: When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell (does NOT consume your reaction): absorb the spell — you take no damage, and you can cast the stored spell on your turn using WILL as your casting stat. You cannot store more than one spell at a time.

abilities.name: Fists of Power
abilities._question: MK5 — no effect id exists for 'unarmed attacks deal true damage'; needs one if this should be auto
abilities.description: Your fists deal true damage for 3 rounds. Costs 0 AP.

abilities.name: Ki Assault
abilities.description: Mark a creature within 100 ft (0 AP). Until the start of your next turn, whenever the marked creature (while within 100 ft of you) uses an ability that would damage you or anyone in your party, you make a free attack on it (attack action, both fists). If it is out of your melee range you blink behind it, attack, and blink back to your initial position.

abilities.name: Dragon Strike
abilities.description: As part of an attack (may be activated AFTER seeing the attack roll's result): a spirit dragon strikes along your fist, dealing an additional 27d10 fire damage.

abilities.name: Chakra Master: Cleanse
abilities._question: MK6 — variable cost: 1 chakra per effect, X chakra for an effect from an Xth-level spell; non-spell effects always 1? AP cost unstated. Also: Chakra Master doubles max chakra (table max 30 -> 60 at L20) — engine support
abilities.description: Consume chakra points to remove negative effects from yourself: 1 chakra per effect, or X chakra for an effect originating from an Xth-level spell. (Chakra Master also doubles your maximum chakra points.)

abilities.name: Focus Conversion
abilities.description: At any point while not under hard CC, for 0 AP: convert any amount of focus into [consumed focus / 4] (rounded down) temporary HP. Variable cost — player chooses how much focus to spend.

abilities.name: Focus: Additional Target
abilities.description: When attacking: also attack an additional target within range. Stacks (spend 20 focus per extra target).

abilities.name: Focus: Empowered Strike
abilities.description: When attacking: deal 1d10 additional damage. Stacks (spend 20 focus per extra 1d10).

abilities.name: Focus: Hindering Strike
abilities._question: MK9 — 'halve the target's MS for the next turn' has no matching effect id (closest: snared); add one?
abilities.description: When attacking: halve the target's MS for the next turn. Does not stack.

abilities.name: Focus: Swift Strikes
abilities._question: MK9 — mapped '-1 AP on the next attack' to reduced-weapon-ap-cost; confirm semantics match
abilities.description: Your next attack costs 1 less AP. Stacks up to 3 times (max -3 AP on one attack).

abilities.name: Spinning Weapon Defence
abilities.description: Spend 1 AP to start channelling until the start of your next turn, spinning your weapon around you. All weapon attacks against you have disadvantage; melee attackers that miss have their weapon thrown 5 ft away. Lasts 1 turn.

abilities.name: Gale of Wind
abilities.description: Unleash a gale of wind in a 50 ft long, 10 ft wide line. All enemies in the line make a DEX save (DC 8 + your proficiency + WILL modifier): on a fail they take [your level x 2]d6 force damage and are knocked prone; on a success they take half the damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Conversion
abilities._question: MK10 — 'frightened' mapped to the terrified effect id; confirm
abilities.description: Convert the damage of an attack (declared before OR after knowing the attack's result) into shadow damage; the target must make a WILL save (DC 8 + your proficiency + WILL modifier) or be frightened for a turn.

abilities.name: Eye of the Mind
abilities.description: Open the eye of the mind until the start of your next turn: truesight 100 ft (blurry shapes, enough to identify objects/persons and their location), advantage on all your attacks and moves, disadvantage on all attacks against you. You CANNOT gain focus while it is active. While active you may use each Eye of the Mind technique once (0 AP each): Impaling Throw, Telekinesis, Immaterial Form.

abilities.name: Eye of the Mind: Impaling Throw
abilities.description: Only while Eye of the Mind is active, once per activation: throw your weapon up to 30 ft, rolling an attack; on a hit deal the weapon's damage. Then teleport to the weapon.

abilities.name: Eye of the Mind: Telekinesis
abilities.description: Only while Eye of the Mind is active, once per activation: move an object/person within 60 ft with telekinesis (a person may make a WILL save to resist). Dropping something on a foe deals [your level]d8 force damage; dropping a foe on the ground can deal [your level]d8 force damage (you choose whether the drop is gentle). You can teleport the target to an unoccupied, non-deadly point within 60 ft of you.

abilities.name: Eye of the Mind: Immaterial Form
abilities._question: MK11 — should 'immaterial, immune to damage' map to the ethereal effect id?
abilities.description: Only while Eye of the Mind is active, once per activation: become immaterial until the start of your next turn, immune to damage.

abilities.name: Molten Meteors
abilities.description: Kneel and summon fiery power: molten meteors fall on ALL enemies within 100 ft. Each makes a DEX save (DC 8 + your proficiency + WILL modifier): 24d12 fire damage on a fail, half on a success. Those who failed take the damage again at the start of each of their turns; they may spend 1 AP to repeat the save (max once per turn) to end it.

abilities.name: Dark Energy Wave
abilities.description: Unleash dark energy radiating from you. All creatures within 10 ft make a DEX save (DC 8 + your proficiency + WILL modifier): 46d12 shadow damage on a fail, half on a success.

abilities.name: Storm Strike
abilities.description: Summon a storm that strikes up to 3 foes of your choice within 100 ft. Each must succeed on a CON save (DC 8 + your proficiency + WILL modifier) or be stunned for up to 3 turns (they may repeat the save each turn).

abilities.name: Unleash the Martyrs
abilities._question: MK12 — first use per rest is FREE, 200 focus after (needs engine support); AP cost of the channel unstated; does the 26d10 spectral hit once per channel turn or once total?
abilities.description: Channel: as long as you are channelling, spirits of your ancestors lunge at your enemies, damaging all targets within 60 ft for 26d10 spectral damage. Taking damage interrupts the channel. You gain no focus while using this ability. Free once per rest; costs 200 focus on subsequent uses.

abilities.name: Sacred Hand (Direct)
abilities.description: Melee 'attack' that heals: consumes up to [WILL modifier + (level+2)d10] sacred energy and restores that same amount of HP to the target (willing targets auto-hit; can target yourself). WILL modifier is added an additional time at levels 5, 9, 13 and 17. If the amount exceeds your remaining sacred energy, consume all remaining and heal that much. Outside of combat, consumes 5x as much sacred energy.

abilities.name: Sacred Hand (Integrated Strike)
abilities._question: MK13 — do the +WILL milestone bonuses (levels 5/9/13/17) also apply to the integrated version, whose base formula has no WILL term?
abilities.description: When attacking with a one-handed weapon or your other fist (not heavy/two-handed), spend +1 AP to apply a lesser Sacred Hand after the attack: consumes up to [(level+2)d10] sacred energy and restores that same amount of HP. Triggers Numinous Strikes (+(2xlevel-3)d4 true damage on the attack from level 2, modified x2 / x0.5 by ally HP state). If the amount exceeds your remaining sacred energy, consume all remaining and heal that much. Outside of combat, consumes 5x as much sacred energy.

abilities.name: Steadfast Touch
abilities.description: Restore 3x the standard (2 AP) Sacred Hand healing, consuming sacred energy equal to the amount healed. Usable WILL-modifier times per rest. From level 20 (Apotheosis) the number of uses is doubled.

abilities.name: Revered Meditation
abilities._question: MK15 — source example uses '2 x spell modifier + 8 + 2d8' which does not match Sacred Hand's formula (stale example?); confirm SE consumed = 2x the single-target heal per tick. Also 'once per short rest' under the round-4 single-rest model
abilities.description: Channel your healing power for up to 3 turns (must have at least 2 AP available to start). At the end of each channelling turn, heal all allies within 30 ft for the standard (2 AP) Sacred Hand healing per 2 AP consumed channelling; you consume 2x the amount you would heal a single creature in sacred energy. Once per rest.

abilities.name: Distant Aid
abilities.description: When using any of your targeted healing abilities, gain 90 ft range on that use. Usable [2 x WILL modifier] times per rest. From level 20 (Apotheosis) the number of uses is doubled.

abilities.name: Cleansing Hand
abilities._question: MK16 — variable SE cost by effect tier; confirm id mapping (knocked down = prone, paralysed = paralyzed, crystalised = crystallised) and that 'other unknown effects' (1000 SE + Medicine check vs the spell's save DC) covers everything not listed
abilities.description: When you heal a creature through an ability, you may also end one negative effect on it (usable on any/all creatures healed by Revered Meditation, paying per creature). Sacred energy cost by effect: burning/poison/poisoned 50; knocked down/rooted/sleeping/blinded 100; silenced/snared/paralysed 200; stunned/petrified/crystallised 500; other unknown effects 1000 plus a Medicine check against the spell's save DC. Effects that cannot normally be dispelled are unaffected. From level 20 (Apotheosis) the cost is halved and no check is required.

abilities.name: Sacramental Renewal
abilities._question: MK17 — cost is a percentage of MAX sacred energy (25%, or 50% in combat to skip the death stack) — needs engine support
abilities.description: Consume 6 AP and 25% of your maximum sacred energy to bring back to life a creature that died within the last 5 minutes, at 50% of its max HP. If revived while combat is ongoing, you may instead consume 50% of your maximum sacred energy so the creature does not gain a death stack; otherwise it must still battle death after combat ends if appropriate (for player characters).
